_comment: Drives eddy.test (probe_eddy_current / LDC1612) under the simavr bridge. 0x7e/0x7f are the manufacturer/device id the driver verifies at startup (TI 0x5449 / LDC1612 0x3055). The DATA0 (0x00/0x01) frequency count and the STATUS register (0x18) are served by the bridge's ldc1612_ramp instead of a static fixture value: eddy_probe_ramp hooks the Z step+dir pins and returns a 28-bit count = baseline_raw + free_per_step * net_descent (net_descent is the absolute, never-reset Z stepper position; descending edges +1, ascending -1). The count climbs as Z descends and crosses the threshold the driver computes from the calibrated descend_z, firing the virtual endstop for G28 homing, BED_MESH_CALIBRATE (default/scan/rapid_scan), and PROBE - which a constant sample can never do (homing 'No trigger on stepper_z'). The count is floored at the calibration's lowest frequency (3.0 MHz = raw 0x2000000) so settled reads at any height map to a valid in-range height rather than an out-of-range/zero (error) sample. descend_level=0 is the DIR level for descending on this cfg's [stepper_z] (PL3 step / PL1 dir). The bridge's uniform-period STATUS pacing + sub-step interpolation (lands DATA0 reads on exact period_cycles boundaries with the fractional count extrapolated from the most recent two same-direction step edges) and the eddy_probe_ramp contact_descent / depress_per_step piecewise knee (drops the per-step climb at a fixed bed contact so the firmware's diff_peak detector sees a clean slope change) carry the synthesized signal end-to-end. The remaining upstream gap (klippy/extras/probe_eddy_current.py _setup_tap had a 4th-order Butterworth lowpass with ~11% step-response overshoot on the derivative, which the noise-free emulator count surfaced as a premature diff_peak_gt trip) was closed by switching that lowpass to a 4th-order Bessel via trigger_analog.DigitalFilter.add_lowpass_bessel: phase-normalized Bessel has effectively no derivative overshoot at the descent-velocity ramps the toolhead actually drives, so the diff_peak peak tracker only updates on the real contact slope change. PROBE METHOD=tap therefore now runs end-to-end under the emulator. intb_pin (PK7) is held low so query_status_ldc1612 reports data-ready; auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires the X/Y cartesian endstops on G28. tick_mode runs the bridge in tick-socket lockstep so the climb + trigger are deterministic regardless of host load.
